title: Parasail Safety Council
specs: Mark McCulloh pioneered modern parasail equipment and holds many patents for commercial parasailing systems
The Parasail Safety Council provides the general public and operators with information on parasailing risk awareness, accident statistics, and safety tips
The Para-Nautique 30 is a 30' winchboat with a 325HP engine and patented Skyrider Gondola system
Most operators claim that you can parasail at 8 years old but recommended minimum age is 14 years to participate and fly only with an adult
gap: No direct offerings or prices for parasailing rides or experiences stated
blurb: The Parasail Safety Council offers information about parasailing safety, history, equipment, and industry standards. It was founded by Mark McCulloh, a pioneer in parasail equipment design and safety. The site provides educational resources, safety tips, and historical context for commercial parasailing.
extraNote: Never fly in rain, fog or an approaching storm fronts in the area; avoid parasailing in winds over 15 mph · If you do not receive a safety briefing do not parasail with that operator
